model: Model D (paper ladder; Model C form, spatial/active-fire objective; GFED5 target)
objective: Spatial Taylor skill (r x sigma) on active-fire cells (GFED5 annual burned fraction > 0.1%), pure spatial (SEAS_W=0); multi-objective NSGA-II traded against false-positive rate. Form identical to Model C. NOTE the topk ranking by spatial_taylor (not internal overall) is the authoritative record of the objective; the plain 'objective' string emitted by the optimizer into per-trial params is a hardcoded label and does not record the run objective.

ed_consistency.interpretation: output is an annual fire rate (yr^-1)

reproduce.fit: SPATIAL_OBJ=1 SEAS_W=0 SAMPLER=nsga2 SEED=42 WARM=params.nsga2.json TAG=paperD python scripts/optimize_modelC_coupled.py
reproduce.burned_area: feed these params through scripts/reproduce_modelC.py (which reads Model C form) to regenerate burntArea.nc

paper_note: Replaces the earlier amp-enabled placeholder. Pure Model-D form (same keys as C, no fire_amp/fuel_k/tropical terms), spatial objective only. Warm-started from C.json. Official ILAMB Overall 0.6411 (paper Table 1).
